description: The wide-box roster (Brad's late-window deep-ITM box): at an hourly close T, pair the :45 15-minute market (anchor A) with the hourly ladder strike whose deep-ITM leg mid is nearest 0.95, scanning T-10min..T-1min and firing the first qualifying instant. 15M leg buys the side toward the anchor (NO if BTC<A, YES if BTC>A); hourly leg buys the opposite deep-ITM side (YES on a strike below A, NO on a strike above A). Values are the scratch wide_box study (TARGET=0.95, MIN15=0.85, start_min=10) mapped to a live book. Not live in Phase 1.
